# gpupaas_kubernetes_cluster (Resource)

A first-class managed Kubernetes cluster (MKS), created from a cluster profile (Kubernetes SKU). Creating the resource provisions the cluster and waits until it is running, which takes many minutes. The cluster is declarative: change `kubernetes_version` to upgrade it, and `worker_pools` (or their `node_count`) to resize it. Use the `gpupaas_kubernetes_sku` data source to see which versions, SKUs, images and datacenters a profile allows; Terraform checks your values against the profile at plan time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# See what the Kubernetes SKU allows first: versions, CNIs, SKUs, images, datacenters.
data "gpupaas_kubernetes_sku" "k8s" {
  project = "system-catalog"
  name    = "mks-oneclick-1"
}

# The workspace (team-a) and the SSH key (cluster-key) must exist: create them with the gpupaas_workspace and
# gpupaas_ssh_key resources, or in the console.

# A one-node cluster. Leave out what the profile already decides (SKU, image, networking,
# blueprint): the provider fills them from the profile and Terraform shows what the platform
# picked as computed attributes.
resource "gpupaas_kubernetes_cluster" "demo" {
  metadata = {
    name      = "demo-cluster"
    project   = "system-catalog"
    workspace = "team-a"
  }

  spec = {
    profile_name       = data.gpupaas_kubernetes_sku.k8s.name
    kubernetes_version = "1.36" # the platform resolves the latest patch; change it to upgrade

    control_plane = {
      node_count = 1 # 1, or 3 / 5 / 7 for high availability
      ssh_key    = "cluster-key"
    }

    # Add, remove or resize pools by editing this list. Pools are identified by name.
    # worker_pools = [
    #   { name = "gpu-pool", node_count = 2, sku_name = "bmaas-test-1", sku_type = "BMAAS" },
    # ]

    tags = { team = "platform" }
  }

  timeouts = {
    create = "60m"
    delete = "30m"
  }
}

output "kubernetes_version" {
  description = "Exact version the cluster runs."
  value       = gpupaas_kubernetes_cluster.demo.status.kubernetes_version
}

output "nodes" {
  value = gpupaas_kubernetes_cluster.demo.status.nodes
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `metadata` (Attributes) Standard metadata block (name, project, workspace, display_name, description, labels, annotations, created_by, modified_by). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `spec` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))

### Optional

- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Remove the cluster record even if the platform cannot tear down its infrastructure (`DELETE ...?force=true`). Leave unset normally: a cluster that failed before anything was provisioned (status `error`, no nodes) is removed this way automatically. Set it only after checking that no machines are left behind.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) Time limits as durations such as `45m`. Defaults: create 60m, update 60m, delete 30m. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<project>/<workspace>/<name>`, or `<project>/<name>` for a project-scoped cluster.
- `status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the resource. Combined with project/workspace to form the unique key.
- `project` (String) Project name that owns this resource. Maps to backend `metadata.project`.

Optional:

- `annotations` (Map of String) Key/value annotations propagated to the backend `metadata.annotations` field.
- `description` (String) Optional free-form description. Maps to backend `metadata.description`.
- `display_name` (String) Optional human-friendly name. Maps to backend `metadata.displayName`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Key/value labels propagated to the backend `metadata.labels` field.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace name that owns this resource. Maps to backend `metadata.workspace`.

Read-Only:

- `modified_by` (Attributes) Backend-observed user that last modified the resource. Populated on reads; ignored on writes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--modified_by))

<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `control_plane` (Attributes) The control-plane nodes. Use 1 node, or 3, 5 or 7 for high availability. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--control_plane))
- `kubernetes_version` (String) Kubernetes version, for example `1.36` (the platform resolves the latest patch) or `v1.36.4`. Changing it upgrades the cluster.
- `profile_name` (String) The cluster profile (Kubernetes SKU) to create the cluster from. Changing it replaces the cluster.

Optional:

- `blueprint` (Attributes) Blueprint applied to the cluster. Defaults to the profile's blueprint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--blueprint))
- `contract_term` (String) Billing contract term in months (`0` is on demand). Must be one the profile allows.
- `location` (String) Datacenter the cluster is placed in. Defaults to the profile's datacenter.
- `networking` (Attributes) Network settings. Defaults come from the profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--networking))
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags for the cluster.
- `worker_pools` (Attributes List) Worker node pools. Add, remove or resize pools by editing this list; pools are identified by `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--worker_pools))

<a id="nestedatt--spec--control_plane"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.control_plane`

Required:

- `node_count` (Number) Number of nodes.

Optional:

- `datacenter` (String) Datacenter for the nodes. Defaults to the cluster `location`.
- `name` (String) Name of the control-plane group.
- `os_image` (String) Operating system image, one of the profile's images. Defaults to the profile's default image.
- `scaling_mode` (String) Scaling mode; `manual` is the supported mode.
- `sku_name` (String) Compute SKU for the nodes (a bare-metal or VM profile name), one of the profile's SKUs. Defaults to the profile's default SKU.
- `sku_type` (String) `BMAAS` (bare metal) or `VMAAS` (virtual machines).
- `ssh_key` (String) Name of an existing SSH key of the workspace to install on the nodes.

Read-Only:

- `compute_type` (String) `CPU` or `GPU`, derived by the platform from the SKU.


<a id="nestedatt--spec--blueprint"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.blueprint`

Optional:

- `name` (String)
- `version` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--spec--networking"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.networking`

Optional:

- `cni_name` (String) CNI plug-in, for example `Calico`.
- `cni_version` (String)
- `pod_subnet` (String) Pod CIDR, for example `10.244.0.0/16`.
- `service_subnet` (String) Service CIDR, for example `10.96.0.0/12`.
- `subnet` (String)
- `vpc` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--spec--worker_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.worker_pools`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the worker pool. It identifies the pool: renaming one removes it and adds a new one.
- `node_count` (Number) Number of nodes.

Optional:

- `datacenter` (String) Datacenter for the nodes. Defaults to the cluster `location`.
- `os_image` (String) Operating system image, one of the profile's images. Defaults to the profile's default image.
- `scaling_mode` (String) Scaling mode; `manual` is the supported mode.
- `sku_name` (String) Compute SKU for the nodes (a bare-metal or VM profile name), one of the profile's SKUs. Defaults to the profile's default SKU.
- `sku_type` (String) `BMAAS` (bare metal) or `VMAAS` (virtual machines).
- `ssh_key` (String) Name of an existing SSH key of the workspace to install on the nodes.



<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)
- `delete` (String)
- `update` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String)
- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster in the Kubernetes management plane.
- `kubernetes_version` (String) Exact Kubernetes version the cluster runs, for example `v1.36.4`.
- `node_count` (Number) Number of nodes registered with the cluster.
- `nodes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status--nodes))
- `phase` (String) Normalized status: `provisioning`, `running`, `updating`, `upgrading`, `degraded`, `error`, `destroying`, ...
- `reason` (String)

Read-Only:

- `kubernetes_version` (String)
- `node_pool` (String) `master` for control-plane nodes, otherwise the worker pool name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# <project>/<workspace>/<name> for a workspace cluster, <project>/<name> for a project cluster.
terraform import gpupaas_kubernetes_cluster.demo system-catalog/team-a/demo-cluster
```
